name: stack-guard
description: One-prompt security check and safe fix for everything you build and run: finds what you run, checks packages, MCP servers and runtimes, reads this fortnight's security news, and applies safe fixes after your yes.

interface.shortDescription: Check your stack for security holes and fix the safe ones
defaultPrompt: Check my stack for security problems, audit only
interface.longDescription: Audit local projects, packages, runtimes, deployment configuration and MCP servers, check this fortnight's security news for your exact versions, then apply approved same-major dependency fixes and verify the result.
